hypothesis: W-R22 mask-aware features completely recovered discrimination when absent rows were explicitly encoded as all-zero sentinel observations. Test whether that apparent robustness transfers to missingness hidden by deterministic nonzero forward-fill or interpolation without any additional missingness channel.
freeze: Fix three observed-value substitution modes, missing tick masks, all generating families, seeds, model budget, and preregistered classification thresholds before original first use. No reuse of W-R22 heldout.
training: Exactly W-R22 development seeds240..255, four frozen clean/augmented models with 1728 paired examples, 32 fixed epochs, 16 weights+bias. No retraining for new missingness encoding.
source: All observations remain 16x4 channel values. Missing positions remain outside anchor0 and four possible swapped true-tick rows11..14. Both positive and negative pair candidates undergo exactly the same missingness replacement before negative-only reordering.
interpolation_rule: Each missing tick and channel replaced by integer floor of mean of nearest previous and next unmasked candidate rows, with offsets bounded within 16-tick observed candidate. No future label, oracle, or additional sensor. Forward fill uses last unmasked preceding row; anchor never masked.
classification: SENTINEL_DEPENDENCE if maskaware_augmented averages>=0.85 across explicit_all_zero cells but <=0.55 across nonzero encoding cells. ENCODING_ROBUST if maskaware_augmented scores>=0.80 in every nonzero encoding cell. MIXED otherwise. Publish all 18 cells per arm and per-seed confusion.
controls: Exact W-R22 source/prereg SHA and parent identity
No model training on W-R22 original heldout or new heldout
All original negative local swaps remain observable and labels distinct
One first-use artifact and final full Go test/build; no retries or acceptance authority changes
claim_limit: Synthetic replacement encoding robustness only; zero-sentinel need not generalize to unmarked loss.
